svg.title: PDE evolution learned in Fourier modal space
svg.desc: Idealized mathematical illustration, not training or prediction performance. The large vector surface and spectral traces are an analytical finite Fourier sum sin(2 pi (x minus 0.55t)) plus higher harmonics. Projection coefficients, a residual-network route and synthesis illustrate learning a finite-dimensional evolution operator. No simulation data or error claim is shown. Based on Wu and Xiu, Journal of Computational Physics 2020, arXiv 1910.06948, Sections 4.1 and 4.2.
svg.text: Project the field · learn the evolution · reconstruct the dynamics
